test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

Madhav applauded her, saying that she had done well.

options.text: Madhav say, “Bravo! You have done well”.
Madhav said, “Bravo! You have done well”.
Madhav said, “Bravo! You been done well”.
Madhav say, “Bravo! You have be done well”.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Madhav said, “Bravo! You have done well”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech.
 
• In direct speech, the reporting verb "**saying**" is changed to "**said**" and the tense of the verb "**had done**" is changed to "**have done**".
 
• The sentence also includes an **exclamation**, which is retained in the direct narration.
 
• Therefore, the correct direct narration is "*Madhav said, 'Bravo! You have done well*'".

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: Incorrect because it uses "say" instead of "said".
 
• **Option 3**: Incorrect because it uses "been done" instead of "have done".
 
• **Option 4**: Incorrect because it uses "be done" instead of "have done".
